presentationRules: Preserve each supplied decoded PNG RGBA pixel; integer-only atlas packing, no resampling or generation
Frame size equals the native NCER box; origin is [-lowX,-lowY], including origins outside the image
One image pixel per native pixel before the existing shared scene transform
Use the existing native bank/sequence/cell snapshots, raw ticks, playback, rotation, flip, tint and alpha
A native transparent cell stays blank; an unknown bank/cell remains missing, never a generated fallback
One shared Pixi atlas source, existing battle actor layer and existing caller ticker; dispose via existing scene
Game loader is allowed only on HTTP(S) localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]
Development server additionally requires a loopback peer and Host for this bundle
Public build omits original reference bundle, retired generated bundle and their index entries
